name: Complemetal 0.4.1 for Minecraft 26.2
changelog: Critical Iris stability release. Fixes the extreme FPS loss, black world, and live-reload crash reported in 0.4.0. Stable Iris rendering now remains fail-open on Iris/OpenGL, full-graph and legacy FINAL cutover cannot overlap, and duplicate Metal world resources stay deferred while shaders are active. The exact JAR passed a real production-client full-modpack test with Complementary Ultra, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling, Lithium, FerriteCore, YACL, Zoomify and related dependencies across fullscreen 1920x1080 at 200 Hz, flight, mining, reloads, dimensions, biomes and two worlds. Controlled A/B: 58.01 vs 51.21 average FPS and zero native faults. Complemetal remains a continuation and fork of MetalRender by pebbles_boon / webblepebbles under Apache-2.0.
